faq.question: Is Kling AI free to use?
faq.answer: Yes! You get 20 free credits when you sign up. Each Kling AI video costs 10 credits, so you can create 2 videos for free to try it out.

faq.question: How long does Kling AI take to generate a video?
faq.answer: Typically 60-90 seconds for a 5-second video, and up to 2 minutes for a 10-second video.

faq.question: What resolution does Kling AI support?
faq.answer: Kling AI supports 480p, 720p, and 1080p resolution outputs.

faq.question: Can I use Kling AI for commercial purposes?
faq.answer: Yes, videos generated with a paid plan can be used commercially. Check our terms of service for details.
